name: Air Plant
hook: Air plant rotting? Dry it upside down after a soak.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: An east or west window is ideal. Outdoors, keep it in the shade so the sun doesn't scorch it.

steps.title: Soak once a week
steps.tip: Soak it in room-temperature water for 20–60 minutes once a week. Soak it less often in winter.

steps.title: Dry it upside down
steps.tip: Shake off the water and dry it upside down for at least 4 hours with good airflow, or the base can rot.

steps.title: Warm days, mild nights
steps.tip: Keep days at 18–32°C and nights above 13°C, away from heaters and AC vents.

steps.title: Feed monthly, very diluted
steps.tip: Once a month, add bromeliad or air plant fertilizer to the soak water at quarter strength.

steps.title: Split off the baby plants
steps.tip: It blooms once, then grows baby plants. Split them off at a third of the parent's size, or keep the clump.

outro: Soak it, dry it upside down, give it light: no soil required.
